title: Missed Membership Payments and Reactivation Periods
content:
# Missed Membership Payments and Reactivation Periods

For the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships, three settings govern a failed membership charge and what follows it. They are identical for all six memberships (Cascade Smile Savings Individual and Household, Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual and Household, and Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual and Household).

| Setting | Value for every membership | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Retry period | 15 calendar days | Calendar days after a failed renewal or monthly charge during which the charge is retried before the membership expires |
| Reactivation window | 60 calendar days | Calendar days after expiry within which the membership may be reactivated by paying the fee |
| Reactivation fee | 0.00 | US dollar fee to reactivate; 0.00 means none |

## Timeline on hypothetical dates

| Point | Hypothetical date | Status of the membership |
|---|---|---|
| A monthly charge fails | May 1 | Active; the charge is retried |
| Last day of the 15 calendar days of retries | May 16 | Active |
| Charge still unpaid after the retry period | — | Expired |

The reactivation window of 60 calendar days runs from the expiry, and reactivating costs the fee due with a reactivation fee of 0.00, that is, no additional fee.
